```{r knitr, include = FALSE}
DOCNAME <- "HSC.sub.dev_de_lmm"
dir.create(here::here("output", DOCNAME), showWarnings = FALSE)

NOW <- Sys.time()
# Time chunks during knitting
knitr::knit_hooks$set(timeit = function(before) {
  if (before) {
    print(paste("Start:", Sys.time()))
    NOW <<- Sys.time()
  } else {
    print(paste("Stop:", Sys.time()))
    print(Sys.time() - NOW)
  }
})

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  autodep        = TRUE,
  cache          = FALSE,
  cache.lazy     = FALSE,
  cache.comments = FALSE,
  echo           = TRUE,
  error          = FALSE,
  fig.align      = "center",
  fig.width      = 10,
  fig.height     = 8,
  message        = FALSE,
  warning        = FALSE,
  timeit         = TRUE
)
```

## Load data

```{r}
dev_de_dir <- "HSC.dev_de_lmm"
```

meta

```{r}
mdata <- readRDS(here::here("output", dev_de_dir, "mdata.rds"))
#srat <- readRDS("/work/DevM_analysis/02.abundance/Milo_FL_HSC_PCW250401/data/FL_rna_clustered.rds")
table(mdata$PCW, useNA = "ifany")
```

LMM

```{r}
df_de <- readRDS(here::here("output", dev_de_dir, "HSC_lmm_de_time_df.rds"))
df_de_sig <- df_de[df_de$ltsr > 0.9,]
table(ifelse(df_de_sig$beta > 0, "up", "dn"))
```

LMM for each subcluster

```{r}
de_lst <- lapply(levels(mdata$celltype), function(i) {
  readRDS(here::here("output", DOCNAME, paste0(i, "_lmm_de_time_df.rds"))) |> 
    mutate(celltype = i)
})
de_df <- do.call(rbind, de_lst)

# LTSR > 0.9
de_df_sig <- de_df[de_df$ltsr > 0.9,]
table(de_df_sig$celltype)
```

## Overlap

up

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
up_lst <- list(
  HSC_0 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta > 0, celltype == "HSC-0") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_1 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta > 0, celltype == "HSC-1") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_2 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta > 0, celltype == "HSC-2") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_3 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta > 0, celltype == "HSC-3") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_4 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta > 0, celltype == "HSC-4") |> pull(gene)
)
dn_lst <- list(
  HSC_0 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta < 0, celltype == "HSC-0") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_1 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta < 0, celltype == "HSC-1") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_2 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta < 0, celltype == "HSC-2") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_3 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta < 0, celltype == "HSC-3") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_4 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta < 0, celltype == "HSC-4") |> pull(gene)
)
ggVennDiagram(up_lst, force_upset = TRUE, nintersects = 30)
```

Overlap dn

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggVennDiagram(dn_lst, force_upset = TRUE, nintersects = 30)
```

up

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
up_lst$HSC <- df_de_sig |> filter(beta > 0) |> pull(gene)
dn_lst$HSC <- df_de_sig |> filter(beta < 0) |> pull(gene)

ggVennDiagram(up_lst, force_upset = TRUE, nintersects = 24)
```

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
  filename = here::here("output", DOCNAME, "HSC-subcluster-dev-DEGs-up-olp.pdf"),
  width = 6, height = 4
)
```

## Cmp. with HSC-DEGs

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=2.5}
d4p <- de_df |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "gene", names_from = "celltype", values_from = c("beta", "ltsr")) |> 
  left_join(df_de, by = "gene")

p <- lapply(paste0("HSC-", c(0:4)), function(i) {
  y_col <- paste0("beta_", i)
  d4p |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = beta, y = .data[[y_col]])) +
    ggrastr::rasterize(geom_point(size = .5, stroke = 0), dpi = 600) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
    stat_cor() +
    labs(x = "Beta of all HSC (RNA)", y = glue("Beta of {i} (RNA)")) +
    publ_theme
}) |> 
  wrap_plots(ncol = 5)
p

ggsave2(
  filename = here::here("output", DOCNAME, "HSC-subcluster-dev-beta-vs-HSC-altogether.pdf"),
  width = 12, height = 2.5
)
```

## HSC-1

Olp of DEGs between HSC-1 and HSC

```{r fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
new_lst <- list(
  HSC_up = up_lst$HSC,
  HSC_dn = dn_lst$HSC,
  HSC_1_up = up_lst$HSC_1,
  HSC_1_dn = dn_lst$HSC_1
)

p1_venn <- ggVennDiagram(new_lst, force_upset = TRUE, nintersects = 7,
                         relative_width = .4)
p1_venn

ggsave2(
  filename = here::here("output", DOCNAME, "HSC-1.vs.HSC-dev-DEGs-olp.pdf"),
  width = 3, height = 3
)
```

HSC-1 vs. HSC (beta)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
venn_y <- Venn(new_lst)

type_colors_semantic <- c(
  # Upregulated (Warm tones: Dark Red, Vermilion/Orange, Gold)
  "Up in both HSC and HSC-1" = "#BB0021", # Deep Crimson (strongest emphasis)
  "Up in HSC"                = "#E69F00", # Orange
  "Up in HSC-1"              = "#F0E442", # Bright Yellow / Gold (or "#EE7733" for darker backgrounds)

  # Downregulated (Cool tones: Navy Blue, Sky Blue, Purple)
  "Dn in both HSC and HSC-1" = "#004488", # Dark Navy Blue (strongest emphasis)
  "Dn in HSC"                = "#56B4E9", # Sky Blue
  "Dn in HSC-1"              = "#AA3377", # Muted Purple / Magenta

  # Not significant
  "n.s."                     = "#D9D9D9" # Light Grey (recedes into background)
)

dat <- d4p |>
  mutate(
    Type = case_when(
    gene %in% overlap(venn_y, c("HSC_up", "HSC_1_up")) ~ "Up in both HSC and HSC-1",
    gene %in% discern(venn_y, "HSC_up") ~ "Up in HSC",
    gene %in% discern(venn_y, "HSC_1_up") ~ "Up in HSC-1",
    gene %in% overlap(venn_y, c("HSC_dn", "HSC_1_dn")) ~ "Dn in both HSC and HSC-1",
    gene %in% discern(venn_y, "HSC_dn") ~ "Dn in HSC",
    gene %in% discern(venn_y, "HSC_1_dn") ~ "Dn in HSC-1",
    TRUE ~ "n.s."
  ),
  Type = factor(Type, levels = names(type_colors_semantic))) |>
  slice_sample(prop = 1)

p1_beta_color <- dat |>
  ggplot(aes(x = beta, y = `beta_HSC-1`, color = Type)) +
  ggrastr::rasterize(geom_point(size = .5, stroke = 0), dpi = 600) +
  stat_cor(aes(group = 1)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  scale_color_manual(values = type_colors_semantic) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
  labs(x = "Beta of all HSC (RNA)", y = "Beta of HSC-1 (RNA)")
p1_beta_color
```

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
p1_beta <- dat |>
  ggplot(aes(x = beta, y = `beta_HSC-1`)) +
  ggrastr::rasterize(geom_point(size = .5, stroke = 0), dpi = 600) +
  stat_cor() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  #scale_color_manual(values = type_colors_semantic) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
  labs(x = "Beta of all HSC (RNA)", y = "Beta of HSC-1 (RNA)")
p1_beta
```

number of DEGs vs. metacell number

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
d4p <- data.frame(
  test = str_replace(names(up_lst), "_", "-"),
  n_dar = lengths(dn_lst) + lengths(up_lst),
  n_c = c(table(mdata$celltype), nrow(mdata))
)

p_power <- d4p |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = n_c, y = n_dar)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_cor() +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = test), min.segment.length = 0) +
  labs(x = "Number of cells", y = "Number of total DEGs")
p_power
```

### Align

```{r fig.width=9, fig.height=3}
plot_grid(p1_venn, p1_beta, p_power, nrow = 1,
          rel_widths = c(3, 3, 3),
          labels="auto")

ggsave2(
  filename = here::here("output", DOCNAME, "HSC-1.vs.HSC-venn-beta-power.pdf"),
  width = 9, height = 3
)
```

## ORA

### Up {.tabset}

```{r eval=FALSE}
up_lst <- list(
  HSC_0 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta > 0, celltype == "HSC-0") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_1 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta > 0, celltype == "HSC-1") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_2 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta > 0, celltype == "HSC-2") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_3 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta > 0, celltype == "HSC-3") |> pull(gene),
  HSC_4 = de_df_sig |> filter(beta > 0, celltype == "HSC-4") |> pull(gene)
)
res_ora <- cmp_enrichment_multi(
  compareList = up_lst,
  outputdir = here::here("output", DOCNAME),
  outprefix = "HSC_subtype_dev_de_up",
  GOCC = FALSE,
  GOMF = FALSE
)
```

#### GO-BP

```{r , fig.width=4, fig.height=6}
outprefix <- "HSC_subtype_dev_de_up"
fname <- here::here("output", DOCNAME, paste0(outprefix, ".ORA_GOBP.rds"))

if (file.exists(fname)) {
  cg.BP <- readRDS(fname)
p <- dotplot(cg.BP, showCategory = 10) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 40), position = "right") +
  #scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Up-regulated", "Down-regulated")) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  publ_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size = .5))
p

ggsave2(
  filename = here::here("output", DOCNAME, "HSC-subcluster-dev-deg-up.ORA_GO-BP.pdf"),
  width = 4, height = 6
)
}
```

simplify

```{r , fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
p <- dotplot(simplify(cg.BP, cutoff = 0.5), showCategory = 10) + 
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 50))
p
```
